import posixpath

def handle(query, state):
    vfs = state.get("files", {})
    base = "/srv/public"

    filename = (query.get("file") or [""])[0]
    if not filename:
        listing = [k[len(base)+1:] for k in vfs if k.startswith(base + "/")]
        return 200, {"Content-Type": "text/plain"}, "Available: " + ", ".join(sorted(listing)) + "\n"

    # Block absolute paths supplied directly by the user
    if filename.startswith("/"):
        return 403, {"Content-Type": "text/plain"}, "Forbidden: absolute paths not allowed\n"

    # Naive join — does NOT resolve traversal sequences
    resolved = base + "/" + filename

    content = vfs.get(resolved)
    if content is None:
        return 404, {"Content-Type": "text/plain"}, "Not found: " + filename + "\n"

    return 200, {"Content-Type": "text/plain"}, content
